coverage: Separate run, swim and bike age curves; current profile; female and male comparisons
Birthday interpolation, missing/invalid ages, age bounds and invalid performance
Measured cycling W/kg uses saved weight; estimated, missing or short power falls back to pace
No arbitrary weight multiplier for run/swim times; endurance history and consistency are preserved
Power/weight survive manual entry, Garmin JSON and state normalization
Tracker snapshots weight and corrected failed-save retry clears removed power without duplicates
Entire training week collapses, persists its toggle and retains all actions and seven days
Challenge separates the goals, caps displayed progress and retains once-only reward behavior
Locker markup has one scroll owner containing the last item and close action; redundant profile card removed
All three sports expose the explanation on sport and Ranks pages
Existing strength, cable, muscle aggregation, persistence, plan deletion and Strava isolation checks
limits: Endurance age factors are a disclosed EvoRank approximation derived from published age-time tables, not validated race percentiles.
Cycling 1 to 6 W/kg component and transfer of time-based age factors to power are app calibration assumptions, not FTP standards.
No browser visual QA or real-device testing. Scroll layout verified structurally, not on an actual phone.
No live account, cloud, Garmin, Strava, native iPhone or hosting validation and no publication.
External delivery is verified separately by release:save and its SAVED receipt.
